canonicalJson: JSON with sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', ASCII only (other characters as u-escapes), no NaN or Infinity, and one trailing LF
hashRule: bundleSha256 is the SHA-256 of the bytes of manifest.json; manifest.json lists every other file with its SHA-256 and byte size
statistics: median and IQR use linear interpolation at index (n - 1) * p over successful repetitions
